Every price, schedule and rule must still be reconfirmed before booking or registration.

sources.title: Venetian Resort Fee policy
sources.notes: States $55 plus tax per night for The Venetian / The Palazzo resort.

sources.title: Venetian direct booking page — Dec 13–20, 2026, one adult
sources.notes: Nov 17 page displayed an estimated $2,369.38 total for the Newly Remodeled Luxury King, including listed resort fees and taxes; the same result showed a capacity/availability warning. Recheck before relying on availability.

sources.title: Venetian Poker Room suite rates and qualification
sources.notes: “As low as” suite rates; tower mapping is unclear. Qualifying play is required per night; do not treat as a general room quote.

sources.title: Venetian Poker Room parking policy
sources.notes: Hotel-guest self-parking $20/day; non-guest $20 Mon–Thu / $25 Fri–Sun; poker-room players with at least three hours of tournament or cash play can receive complimentary self-parking for the day, with supervisor confirmation. Rates may change.

sources.title: Venetian contact and official address
sources.notes: Official property address: 3355 Las Vegas Blvd S, Las Vegas, NV 89109.

sources.title: WPT World Championship Festival schedule PDF (Wynn-hosted)
sources.notes: Official Wynn-hosted festival schedule PDF; use with event-specific WPT pages and structures. The current page is not treated as a complete citywide calendar.

sources.title: WPT World Championship event details and terms
sources.publisher: World Poker Tour / Wynn Las Vegas
sources.notes: Dec 13–20, $10,400; four-entry maximum: one entry per starting flight plus one Day 2 entry before Day 2; $1,000,000 added refers to mystery payouts, not a guaranteed player prize pool.

sources.title: ClubWPT Gold Super Gold Million event page
sources.notes: Dec 10–14, $400, $3,000,000 guarantee; page schedule lists Day 3 Dec 13 and Final Table Dec 14 as continuations. No new entry is listed on those days.

sources.title: WPT Super Gold Million announcement and entry terms
sources.notes: Official release says the Super Gold Million has four starting flights and unlimited re-entry; its Dec 10–14 series dates overlap the research window only for continuation days.

sources.title: WPT World Championship festival structures and event terms
sources.publisher: World Poker Tour / Wynn Las Vegas
sources.notes: Official event-specific schedules and rules. Includes $600 NLH Turbo and Mixed Triple Draw re-entry terms and WPT entry/fee rules.

sources.title: WPT Ladies Championship official event page and details
sources.notes: Dec 13–14, $1,100, $250,000 guarantee, 11 a.m. start; the reviewed official page does not establish an entry cap or re-entry rule.

sources.title: Wynn Resort King direct room-rate page — Dec 13–20, 2026
sources.notes: Nov 17 display: $355 average/night including resort fee, excluding taxes; no tax-inclusive total returned. The $2,817.49 value is an estimate, not a hotel quote.

sources.title: Wynn resort fee and reservation terms
sources.notes: $55 daily resort fee plus tax for purchased or complimentary room nights; page includes Wynn and Encore terms.

sources.title: Wynn parking policy
sources.notes: Registered hotel guests and Wynn Poker Room guests get complimentary self-parking, subject to availability; non-guests pay $25/day after the first three hours; valet $40/day.
